brief.headline: Bounce Theory doubled to 97K views; TikTok still stuck near 250
brief.summary: Bounce Theory's 28-day views jumped from 46.1K to 97.4K since yesterday (+76 subs), carried by pendulum waves, brick breakers and string art, and Ambient Escape rose to 24.9K. TikTok hasn't recovered: your last five videos landed near 250 views and followers are flat at 178, so the team says go 30-40 seconds, stay on niche, and use specific captions. Your best TikTok today is the Ramadan lock-in idea, with the Epictetus 'out of control' video right behind it.
filmToday: TikTok: Lock in for Ramadan, not January — Everyone's locking in till December 31st. I think we picked the wrong finish line.
TikTok: Epictetus' fix for feeling out of control — Six in ten guys our age feel like they've got barely any control over their life.
YouTube (Bounce Theory): Soft Body 0% vs 100% Escape — approved; the same format is a 40x outlier (4.2M views) right now.
